claims: As of early April 2026, the national average 30-year fixed mortgage rate is hovering around 6.45% to 6.58%.
Previous weekly averages were 6.38%, according to Freddie Mac.
The 30-year refinance APR is averaging around 6.78%.
According to Freddie Mac data as of April 3, 2026, the national average 30-year fixed mortgage rate is 6.45% - 6.58%.
According to Freddie Mac data as of April 3, 2026, the weekly average is 6.46%.
According to Freddie Mac data as of April 3, 2026, the refinance average 30-year fixed is 6.78%.
According to Freddie Mac data as of April 3, 2026, the VA 30-year fixed is ~5.93%.
Daily rates shifted to 6.45% by April 3, 2026.
